title: Sushi, Salads, BBQ and Cheese Boards: Pregnancy Food-Safety Analysis
excerpt: Analyzing food safety for pregnant women with international dishes like sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, choosing safe and nutritious food is crucial. However, with the diversity of international dishes, many pregnant women feel confused about what to choose and what to avoid. In this article, we will analyze food safety for pregnant women with international dishes like sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards.

## Food Safety Analysis
According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/people-at-risk/pregnant-women.html) and [NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/pregnancy/keeping-well/foods-to-avoid/), when pregnant, it is recommended to avoid foods that have a high risk of containing bacteria, viruses, and parasites. Below is an analysis of food safety for pregnant women with international dishes:

* Sushi: Pregnant women should avoid raw or undercooked sushi, as it may contain bacteria and parasites. However, cooked or pasteurized sushi is safe.
* Salads: Salads are a good choice for pregnant women, but they should choose fresh vegetables and avoid contaminated ones.
* BBQ: BBQ is a good choice for pregnant women, but they should choose well-cooked meat and avoid raw or undercooked meat.
* Cheese boards: Pregnant women should choose pasteurized cheese and avoid raw or unpasteurized cheese.

## Nutrient Combination
To ensure adequate nutrition for pregnant women, it is recommended to combine international dishes with other nutrient-rich foods. Below are some suggestions:

* Combine cooked sushi with fresh vegetables and fruits to provide adequate vitamins and minerals.
* Combine salads with well-cooked meat and pasteurized cheese to provide adequate protein and calcium.
* Combine BBQ with fresh vegetables and fruits to provide adequate vitamins and minerals.

## Foods to Avoid
Below are some international dishes that pregnant women should avoid:

* Raw or undercooked sushi
* Contaminated salads
* Raw or undercooked meat
* Raw or unpasteurized cheese

## Conclusion
When pregnant, choosing safe and nutritious food is crucial. Hopefully, through this article, pregnant women will be able to choose safe and nutritious international dishes for themselves. For more information on pregnancy meal planning, you can visit our [website](/planner) or [read more about prenatal nutrition](/blog/topics).

## Note
Before making any changes to their diet, pregnant women should consult with their doctor or a registered dietitian to ensure safety and effectiveness.
